review_register.instructions: Each role records the actual reviewer, dated completion, verdict and concrete evidence. The PDF visual review is bound to the exact final PDF SHA256 and explicitly covers every page 1 through 82.

evidence: Supplied YesMilano outdoor-trips page audited destination by destination
content_milan_excursions.py contains every one of the 15 main-page YesMilano candidates
YesMilano discovery and related-itinerary links are visible in the exact 211-link directory
findings: Discovery copy was retained as lineage only; first-party transport, operator, municipality or park pages control planning claims.

evidence: Supplied Hotels.com nature-list page audited headline by headline
All 10 headline destinations are represented; overlaps with YesMilano are deliberately deduplicated
MX01 explicitly captures the Pianico-Sellere and Sovere Fossil Lakes branch with a regional control
findings: The Hotels.com page was rate-limited during the final automated audit, but its already-audited URL remains visible as discovery lineage; no operational claim depends on it.

evidence: Final MX01-MX30 source-and-safety review in content_milan_excursions.py
MX28 ordinary Vanzago guided-walk wording corrected and exact operator visit page added
MX16 PostBus live-timetable entry and official 2026 line 321 network plan added
MX10 season wording corrected to year-round with dated hours, boat and lift checks
findings: Four concrete review notes were resolved before the final build; no critical or unsafe defect remained.
